summary: A menu item that opens another menu beside it.

root.note: A box around the item; it is the anchor its menu is placed against.

keys.ArrowRight, Enter, Space: On the item: open the menu with focus on its first item. ArrowRight is the arrow pointing at the inline end, ArrowLeft in a right-to-left page.
keys.ArrowLeft, Escape: Inside the menu: close it and return focus to the item, leaving the menu around it open. ArrowLeft is the arrow pointing at the inline start.

guidance.text: It holds one menu item and one menu, and is itself an item of the menu around it. The arrows follow the writing direction.

notYet: Opening when the pointer rests on the item.
